name: Xizang Mineral Development Co. LTD
summary: Xizang Mineral Development Co. LTD engages in mining business. The company explores for chromite, copper, lithium, and boron deposits. It also offers lithium batteries that are used in information products, cameras, electric vehicles, and civil power peak-shaving power supplies. The company serves atomic energy, aerospace, and metallurgical industries. The company was formerly known as Tibet Mineral Development Co. Ltd. Xizang Mineral Development Co. LTD was founded in 1994 and is based in Lhasa, China.
